ROBOTICS SOFTWARE ENGINEER · TORONTO, CANADA

Jonathan Spraggett.

I build autonomy systems for robots that have to work in the real world.

I lead the development of autonomy software for a heavy-lift eVTOL at Mostavio, working across motion planning, state estimation, perception, controls and flight testing. I also conduct research in robotics, from flight control to reinforcement learning for humanoids.

ROBOT LEARNING · ROBOCUP 2025

One policy, seven humanoids ↗

A unified CrossQ reinforcement learning policy with up to 86 ± 7% zero-shot recovery success.

CONTROLS · AIAA 2026

Flight-tested control & filtering ↗

Frequency-domain vibration mitigation and stability analysis validated on the actual aircraft.

HUMANOIDS · UNDERGRADUATE THESIS

Sim2Real soccer skills ↗

PPO and adversarial motion priors for walking, jumping and kicking in simulation.
